question: Who has been appointed as the new CEO of the Professional Golf Tour of India (PGTI) starting January 2025?
solution: The correct answer is __**Amandeep Johl**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__** • ** The Professional Golf Tour of India (PGTI) announced the appointment of Amandeep Johl as its new Chief Executive Officer (CEO) starting January 2025.**
